name: mova-agent-api-phase1
description: Validation tooling for MOVA Agent API V0 schemas and OpenAPI surface.

scripts.validate:examples: ajv validate --spec=draft2020 -c ajv-formats -s schemas/request_envelope.schema.json -r schemas/action.schema.json -d examples/agent_request_minimal.json --strict=false && ajv validate --spec=draft2020 -c ajv-formats -s schemas/policy_admission.schema.json -d examples/policy_admission_minimal.json --strict=false && ajv validate --spec=draft2020 -c ajv-formats -s schemas/connector_call.schema.json -r schemas/policy_admission.schema.json -d examples/connector_call_minimal.json --strict=false && ajv validate --spec=draft2020 -c ajv-formats -s schemas/observation_record.schema.json -d examples/observation_record_minimal.json --strict=false && ajv validate --spec=draft2020 -c ajv-formats -s schemas/evidence_response.schema.json -d examples/evidence_response_minimal.json --strict=false
scripts.validate:all: npm run validate:examples && npm run validate:openapi
